name: notebooklm-microlearning
description: Turn any topic into a NotebookLM audio or slide podcast for microlearning — generates a structured source document and, if the bundled MCP server is connected, creates it directly in your NotebookLM notebook. Requires an existing Google account with NotebookLM access.

default_language.title: Default output language
default_language.description: Language for the generated source document and NotebookLM prompt (e.g. 'English', 'Czech'). English is a reasonable default — NotebookLM's English outputs tend to be more information-dense than other languages.

explanation_style.title: Explanation style
explanation_style.description: How each concept in the source document should be taught. Keep the default, or describe your own style.
explanation_style.default: Explain the concept, demonstrate with a concrete example, give the exact command or step, then explain in plain language what it actually does — structured as one end-to-end walkthrough, not isolated facts.

notebook_name.title: NotebookLM notebook name
notebook_name.description: Name of the single, persistent NotebookLM notebook this skill reuses for every topic. It never creates a new one automatically. Create this notebook once yourself at notebooklm.google.com before first use.

expertise_level.title: Explanation calibration
expertise_level.description: Your background, so explanations are pitched correctly: 'no technical background', 'some technical background', or 'developer'.

wait_for_completion.title: Wait for podcast generation to finish
wait_for_completion.description: If enabled, Claude monitors generation until it's done and reports back. If disabled (default), Claude starts generation and returns immediately — check the notebook link when you're ready, no need to keep the session open.
